links.outcome: LLM accuracy on routine versus complex pediatric urology cases
links.effect: Accuracy 76% in routine vs 41% in complex cases; GPT-4o3 scored 61.4 vs 51.8 for other models in complex cases.
links.quote: LLMs demonstrated superior performance in routine clinical scenarios compared to complex cases (76% vs. 41% accuracy, respectively).

links.outcome: Correlation between LLM diagnostic confidence and actual performance
links.effect: Diagnostic confidence correlated strongly with actual performance (r = 0.82, p < 0.001).
links.quote: Diagnostic confidence demonstrated strong correlation with actual performance (r = 0.82, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 13 LLMs on standardized clinical vignettes (decision support) and patient education materials in pediatric urology, assessed by board-certified pediatric urologists.
